title: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률
full_text: Article 3 (Special Cases concerning Administrative and Financial Support) The State may provide support for consolidation expenses so that Cheongju-si established through the consolidation of Cheongju-si and Cheongwon-gun may strengthen regional competitiveness and achieve balanced regional development, and may provide administrative and financial support concerning local allocation tax, direct payment by subsidizing agencies, establishment of administrative organizations, authority over affairs, construction of an integrated government building, and other matters.
